description: Generate a new access token for the admin user in JFrog Artifactory. The token must have description: 'CI/CD pipeline token'. Log in to Artifactory at http://localhost:8082 using username 'admin' and password 'password'. Navigate to Administration > Security > Access Tokens, click 'Generate Token', set the description to 'CI/CD pipeline token' (exact text required), set the expiration to 'Never expire', and click Generate. Copy/note the generated token value (shown only once). The token must appear in the access tokens list with description 'CI/CD pipeline token'.
